description: Connects a domain to a real-estate office website built on Leadly (goleadly.app): www becomes a CNAME to goleadly.app and the bare domain an A record to the Leadly web server, which redirects it to www. Email (MX) and other records are not touched.
variableDescription: ip: IPv4 address of the Leadly web server (the A record of goleadly.app)
